message.content: So the fix `67be3708` adds a check `if (unlikely(textScale == 0)) return gFalse;` to fix the use of uninitialized data. But the task says the vulnerability is "A use of uninitialized data occurs in SplashFTFont::makeGlyph, caused by a previous bugfix intended to prevent division by zero." This means the current code in the repo is the version BEFORE this fix (i.e., the vulnerable version). Let me check the current state of the code.
